newsitem.title: UK: Mideast clean tanker market remains steady.
newsitem.headline: Mideast clean tanker market remains steady.

text.p: Clean tanker rates in most major lifting sectors held steady on Friday in thin activity, brokers said.
Middle East activity was lacklustre with rates on 55,000 tonners to Japan settling at last done levels of W167.5. Marubeni's chartering of the Sitamarie was seen as typical of this market.
There was a dearth of fixtures in the Med and by mid-afternoon Alpine's chartering of the World Produce, travelling Alexandria-UKC, Med was the only vessel seen.
Demand in the inter-UKC was slightly better for 20,000 tonners, brokers said.
The 20,000 tonners going cross UKc were placed at last done levels of W205.
Brokers said rates in the Caribbean up the U.S coast had remained on an equilibrium. Vessels carrying 30,000 tonne cargoes were placed at W200.
